options.presentMode.unsupported: This mode is NOT supported on current device!
options.presentMode.FIFO:
Standard vsync. Presents frames at a fixed interval matching the display refresh rate.
§2No screen tearing.§r
§4High input latency, especially when FPS drops below refresh rate.§r
options.presentMode.FIFO_RELAXED:
"Improved" vsync. Presents next frame immediately when a frame takes too long, instead of waiting for the next refresh cycle.
§6Slight screen tearing possible when FPS is below refresh rate.§r
§2Mid input latency, generally better than `FIFO`.§r
options.presentMode.MAILBOX:
Another non-vsync mode. Always presents the latest fully rendered frame, discarding older queued frames.
§2No screen tearing.§r
§aLow input latency, close to IMMEDIATE.§r
options.presentMode.IMMEDIATE:
Traditional non-vsync mode. Presents the latest frame as soon as it is rendered, even if the previous frame is still being displayed.
§4Always causes screen tearing.§r
§2Lowest input latency, as its name implies.§r
